dataList.content:
It hurts... it hurts... it hurts...!
好痛……好痛……好痛啊……！

dataList.content:
Yes, I love it when humans let their blood boil... But this... this is too painful...!
啊啊，我说过喜欢热血沸腾的人类。但这……太痛了……！

This guy keeps regenerating... no matter how many times we tear him to pieces... Ngh...
这家伙，就算被打得四分五裂也还能粘回来……可恶……

Haah... this... I don't know if we can...
哈啊……再这样下去……很难……镇压吧……

The mental fatigue finally got to Gregor and Sinclair, and they collapsed to the ground. The strange environment of WARP trains was proving to be a significant boost to the Bloodfiend's regenerative ability.
话音刚落，心力交瘁的格里高尔和辛克莱瘫倒在地。在绝对不会死亡的WARP列车内部特性的影响下，血魔的再生能力变成了巨大的阻碍。

The battle trudged on without an end in sight. At this point, we've already been fighting for much longer than we had at the K Corp. border checkpoint or at the basement of Wuthering Heights. The Sinners had all grown much stronger since then, but even they were reaching a breaking point.
虽然和在K公司检查站以及呼啸山庄地下的经历很像，但这次的战斗要更加漫长，似乎漫无尽头。罪人们虽然与那时相比获得了成长，但是也快到极限了。

Don Quixote continues to wildly pummel the Bloodfiend with her lance, breaking, stabbing, and crushing him every time a body part regenerated.
其中堂吉诃德格外难以抑制愤怒，不断地对着正在恢复的血魔突刺。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
I am... I am so very hungry...
我……十分……十分饥饿……

Ridiculous! Thy hunger is no justification for this massacre thou hast wrought!
只是因为饥饿就进行如此多的屠戮吗！汝认为这足以成为借口吗？

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Shut up! Y-you, you, you don't understand.
闭嘴！你、你根本不懂。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
You don't know how awful it is to— I survived for two hundred years on that disgusting... horrible— N-no, NO! I don't even want to think about it!
这、这两百年间……所进食的血……是多么令人作呕……不、不要！我不想回忆起来！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Shut up! Be quiet! No, I'm... I'm sorry, I'll be good... Please, please, please let me have just a sip... just the smallest sip... Please...
闭嘴，缄默！不对，对不起……请给我喝一口……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Nngh... it won't matter... how many times you stab me...
咕唔……毫无意义……不论你再刺我多少次……

I shan't stop until all of thy flesh and bone and organs are crushed into a viscous, shapeless mush, never to become whole again!!!
直至汝彻底被击垮成肉泥之前，吾之攻击都不会停止！！！

But... the Bloodfiend's regeneration is so powerful that he's recovering as fast as Don Quixote is destroying him.
然而……这位血魔……在无止尽的穿刺中无止尽地恢复。

<He's regenerating at an insane rate... We can't...>
<恢复得太快了……再这样下去的话……>

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Agh... My Kindred... my Child!!!
咕……眷属……我的子嗣！！！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
I have given thee new life, invited thee to this banquet...!
是我赐予你新一次生命，邀你参与这场宴会……！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
So do something! Your responsibilities! The blessings of your Father must be repaid, no?!
因此你也应尽你的职责！回报你父亲的恩赐！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Wh-what can I do...?
我……我应该做什么……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Find their weakness, break their anchor...! Make them kneel and grovel before me in desperation, just as you had...!
找到他们的弱点。正如你向我乞怜一样……也令他们只能跪倒在我面前……！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
W-wait, I think I've got an idea...
要、要说……有什么在意的地方……

Sasha began looking around wildly, surprised by Cassetti's sudden command...
萨莎对卡塞蒂的话感到困惑，开始环顾四周……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
It's that the way they fight... reminds me a lot of the way we prosthetic-using Fixers fight.
那些人……和我们这些义体收尾人采取了相似的战斗方式。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
... Just as Prosthetic Fixers slowly lose their sense of self-preservation, their limbs becoming no more than tools to be replaced...
……义体持有者们会觉得，只是丢一两条手脚无伤大雅，然后逐渐丧失对生命的重视……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
... these idiots act with such abandon, as if they have multiple lives to burn through.
他们也像是有好几条命一样在轻率地行动。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
With nothing to protect, they throw themselves wildly into battle like moths to a flame...
因为没有需要守护的东西所以才能集中精神战斗……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
And... heh heh... forget to look after what's really important. Like this little thing.
最后，呵呵……才会像这样把重要的东西轻易弄丢啊。

With one of her remaining arms, Sasha picked up from the ground...
萨莎用剩下的一只手臂从地上捡起的是……

... the master keycard Faust showed her in one of the previous cars.
浮士德在之前的车厢给我们看过的主钥匙卡。

Don Quixote! Stop her, now!
阻止她，堂吉诃德！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
O my Father... I offer this gift to you...!
父亲啊……我向您献上此物……！

Gah...!
唔……

Don Quixote immediately leaped at the Fixer, but one of her arms struck her away with great force.
堂吉诃德立刻飞奔向萨莎……但她用一只胳膊将堂吉诃德用力推开……

Ishmael and Meursault, who had been holding Cassetti down, were no match for his strength without Don Quixote's fury. The Bloodfiend threw them both to the side and grabbed the keycard.
这期间正在抵抗卡塞蒂的以实玛利和默尔索相继倒下，主钥匙卡被交到了卡塞蒂手上。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
This is the key to the first class cars, my Lord... With this, grow your army of Bloodbags... For the kingdom's prosperity...
这是前往头等舱的钥匙……如此一来便能制造更多的血袋……令王国繁荣……

Cassetti examines the master keycard with clear interest.
卡塞蒂饶有兴趣地看着递交到自己手中的主钥匙卡。

Without that keycard... we'll be trapped inside this train for thousands of years until it reaches its destination.
要是没了那个，我们就得被关在这个地方数千年，直到列车到站。

Dante...
但丁……

I believe that I have tried my utmost to overcome this adversity...
如今无法阅览浮士德情报的我……

... without access to Faust's knowledge and intelligence.
也尽了最大的努力，试图渡过本次难关。

However...
然而……

With our loss of the master keycard... the uncertainty of this circumstance has been greatly exacerbated.
在主钥匙卡被那人得手的情况下……一切变得更加难以确定。

At the origin of this plight...
其原因可能是……

Faust took a deep breath, as if she was about to take a deep dive into the source of all this trouble...
浮士德像是深入探寻了这一切开始的源头，随后缓缓呼气。

... must be my overreliance on Faust.
至今为止都太过依靠浮士德了吧。

From what I can tell, Faust has always been operating based on information she received from "Faust." So a situation like this, where she has to make decisions on her own, must be unfamiliar to her.
浮士德认为自己无论遇到什么情况都能通过“浮士德”获取信息。因此，她还不习惯像这样需要依靠自己进行判断的情况吧。

... But Faust is an exceptional Sinner with or without"'Faust."
但是……即使没有那些帮助，浮士德也是极其优秀的罪人。

<I've been thinking the same thing about myself, actually. That I might've been relying too much on that... perfect Faust.>
<我觉得我也一样……太依靠那个完美的浮士德了。>

<But even without "Faust," you've still guided us masterfully after analyzing the information we brought you.>
<但是只要和罪人们一起搜集各式各样的信息……最后浮士德也会一如既往地提出优秀的方案。>

<Maybe... uncertainty itself doesn't always have to be a problem for us.>
<或许……不确定性对我们来说并不算是大问题吧。>

<Remember? "Thus the lack of plan itself becomes the plan". You said it yourself.>
<你以前说过吧。没有计划也是一种计划。>

... I see.
……是吗。

Indeed, among many, I am a Faust that believes in uncertainty.
我在浮士德之中，也是格外相信不确定性的浮士德。

Our loss of the master keycard is but one of innumerable uncertain variables in the equation.
主钥匙卡被夺走不过是众多不确定性之中的一个……

The constant is, however...
可以确定的是……

... that the Bloodfiend is just as desperate as we are.
他们和我们……都很迫切。既然如此……

Thus the only option that remains at present is to... compromise.
只能……进行交涉。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
You there... Looks like thou art the one who's been regenerating your friends...
来吧……看看他们的样子，那人应当有恢复的能力……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Stop... stop doing that, alright? Don't heal a single one them.
现在……从现在起不准再恢复他们……懂了吗？

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Or I'll smash your precious key to pieces!
否则我就让这钥匙化作齑粉！

M-Manager Esquire...
经……经理老爷……

Compromise...? To compromise with a villain as vile as that cur...!
交涉……那难道不是在向恶人妥协吗……！

I didn't have the time to regenerate Don Quixote's severe injuries just yet. And the rest of the Sinners were already unconscious...
一眼就能看出堂吉诃德身受重伤，罪人们也失去了意识。

The only Sinner who could still move and talk... was Faust, whom I just rewound the clock for.
在堂吉诃德也无法行动的现在，能正常进行对话和行动的就只有最后一次转动时钟恢复过来的浮士德。

<... Yeah... Let's do that.>
<好……就这么做吧……>

Very well. Then... Cassetti, why don't we move this conversation to a different location?
那么……卡塞蒂，可以换个地方吗？

I alone will accompany Dante to this negotiation. Let me make my intentions clear now: Dante and I will not attack you there.
只有我和但丁经理一同前往。事先声明，我们不会在那里攻击你。

There is no doubt in my mind that Cassetti must also be exhausted by the unending barrage of attacks from Don Quixote and the Sinners.
卡塞蒂一定也因为刚刚堂吉诃德的胡乱刺击和罪人们的攻击而精疲力尽。

So, Faust's suggestion that we move this conversation to a different place without the Sinners must've sounded pretty sweet to him.
对于浮士德提出的前往没有其他人的场所这一建议，卡塞蒂也表现出了兴趣。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
J-just you two, huh?
没……没有其他人的地方？

Yes. As you are aware, the freight car is immediately adjacent to this one; that is where we will further discuss what we each have to offer to one another.
没错。正如你所知，就是这前方的货运车厢。我们可以在那里针对互相的诉求进行协商。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
That... that clock must be thy monarch then, hm? And thou art one of the retainers.
那么那个……那个混蛋时钟就是你们的王。对吧？而你是他的仆从。

Correct.
是的。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Very well... this will be a royal debate, then! It is only right that a member of royalty talks to no one else but the one who is his equal!
好……那这是王与王之间的平等交流！

Manager... Esquire...
经理老爷……

<We'll be back in a minute... Don Quixote.>
<堂吉诃德……在这里等一小会。>

Thus we left the incapacitated Sinners and Don Quixote, who watched on with hollow, despondent eyes as we walked away. We carefully made our way into the freight car.
随后我们离开了倒在地上的罪人们，以及用空洞的眼神望着我们的堂吉诃德……慢慢走向货运车厢里。

<So Faust, why are we doing this in the freight car again...?>
<浮士德，为什么要去货运车厢……>

Dante... this will be my first attempt...
但丁……这是我第一次……

... at a "gamble."
想尝试赌一把。

With that, the door closed shut behind us.
伴随着浮士德的话语，车门关上了。
